question: Does the product/action weighting difference seen in the Sunset canary recur across active planned windows because acquisition protocols use different bracket lengths?
terminal_objective: Classify every active plan window by its admitted per-action exposure counts and quantify product/action and byte/action ranges without treating windows as a partition or inferring image content.
method: Replay Stage 11E, join each nonblank Stage 10Z plan membership to unique Stage 10O actions, classify a window as pure-three, pure-five, or mixed from the exposure count of every admitted action, and compare per-action product and byte weights. Do not sum windows because memberships overlap.
authority: Private local relationship and accounting analysis only. No pixels, window-partition claim, image-content claim, representation-value judgment, actual sampler claim, observed model behavior, causal effect, archive-wide extrapolation, scientific result, novelty, or priority claim.
claim_ceiling: Stage 11F may establish that 19 of 36 active plan windows contain only admitted three-exposure actions, 11 contain only admitted five-exposure actions, and six are mixed. Because each exposure has three representations in the verified cohort, the pure-five windows carry 15 products per action versus nine for pure-three windows, a 1.666667-fold product weight at equal action count. Per-window byte/action values span 546.814 MB to 1.970 GB, and Sunset is in the 15-product/action class. It cannot treat overlapping plan windows as a partition, turn product weight into image-content or scientific-value weight, assert an actual sampler or observed model bias, infer a causal performance effect, extend to unadmitted archive records, or make a physical-science, novelty, or priority claim.

next_step_logic.if_public_analysis_is_selected: Use the 19/11/6 window census to show that implicit weighting is protocol-wide, not a Sunset-only anomaly; retain Sunset as the vivid high-volume example.
next_step_logic.if_a_model_task_is_selected: Balance or report action and event weights explicitly, and include bracket length or exposure count as a metadata control.
next_step_logic.if_overlapping_windows_are_aggregated: Stop and return to the Stage 10Z many-to-many ledger; window totals cannot be summed as disjoint cohorts.
next_step_logic.if_a_new_action_pattern_is_admitted: Recompute this census before reusing any ratio.
next_step_logic.recheck_trigger: A revised action oracle, relationship manifest, plan ledger, or actual sampler.
